This article is a stub. Lab Software Associates was an American swimming software company
based in Wilton, Connecticut, which advertised its
[LSA SwimMeet and SwimTeam](../software/lsa-swimmeet.md) programs for IBM PCs in Swimming
World from 1985 to 1998.

See the [vendors overview](index.md) for the other companies this wiki covers.
